correctness.rationale: The pinned RESULT.md gives a complete optimization, not a sampled optimum. With Alice marginal I/2 every Bloch effect |m|<=1 is available, the coherence of Bob’s conditional state in the *post-damping Bob marginal* eigenbasis is the norm of the perpendicular projection, and its maximum is the largest projected T singular value. Damping sends b to (sqrt(q) beta,0,gamma) and T to diag(sqrt(q) tau,sqrt(q) kappa,q kappa). The two orthogonal projected rows give the exact two branches. Subtracting initial kappa^2 yields gamma P(gamma)/(gamma²+q beta²); concavity, endpoint negatives, internal vertex, and discriminant factorization give iff tau²>kappa²(1+beta²+2 sqrt(2) beta) and a single strict interval. State eigenvalues and its PPT eigenvalues nonnegative under 1-tau>=sqrt(beta²+4kappa²) establish physical separability for 2x2 systems. Direct independently calculated rational witness at (1/4,1/8,1/2),gamma=1/2 has coherence-square 257/2304 vs initial 1/64; boundary gamma=0,1 checked. This finite witness corroborates the analytic continuum proof, not replacing it.
